description:
Add the missing CLI commands that the meta-optimization team needs to invoke DTV.

Commands to implement:
- development-toolchain-validator validate <reference> — Trigger validation run for a reference, display results
- development-toolchain-validator report --conflicts — Show cross-skill contradictions
- development-toolchain-validator report --drift — Show skills with content drift
- development-toolchain-validator report --maturity — Show skill maturity scores
- development-toolchain-validator report --tool-baselines — Show tool accuracy regressions
- development-toolchain-validator expectation structural list|create|get|delete — CRUD for structural expectations
- development-toolchain-validator expectation cli list|create|get|delete — CRUD for CLI assertions

All commands are thin wrappers over the API following the existing reference/connection command patterns. Depends on both validation API and report generation being complete.
name: dtv-cli-validate-and-report
title: CLI Commands: validate, report, expectation
